product_one_liner.value: Typeface is an agentic AI marketing platform for enterprise marketing teams that creates personalized, on-brand content and orchestrates campaigns across their existing tools and workflows.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found on the official site, and /pricing returned no readable pricing page; the site directs prospects to request a demo.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported employee count, rather than the broader and inconsistent company-size label; sources report approximately 298–304 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts within the main blog, rather than a separate engineering publication: the R&D president explains the orchestration architecture, and the CISO, whose background includes security engineering, explains fine-tuning data provenance, bias assessments, safety validation and release gates.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior ML Engineer is listed on the open-roles board and has a readable direct job posting; availability reflects the retrieved listing.

model_provider.notes: Typeface explicitly says it orchestrates agents across 20+ models from these providers and others.

compliance_certs.notes: Only certifications from the five requested categories are included.

last_funding.notes: Latest dated secondary report: October 11, 2025. Not confirmed by a Typeface announcement found in this research. Funding sources conflict: CB Insights instead lists a September 2025 unattributed VC round with no amount; the latest company announcement found is the June 2023 $100M Series B. Treat the Series C figures as reported, not independently confirmed.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 11, 2025 funding report falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. This relies on secondary reporting; the stage and amount are disputed across funding sources.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive; the open-roles board lists East, West and London account-executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: September 22, 2026: announced the next generation of the Typeface Orchestration Engine, combining Arc Graph, Arc Fabric and Arc Loop; within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Satya Krishnaswamy announced joining as Chief Customer Officer on November 10, 2025, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly documented integrations supported by Typeface; this is an integration-stack signal, not proof that Typeface uses each system internally for its own sales or marketing.
